title: PocketWorld device v1
description: Machine-readable wire shapes. Native validators additionally enforce UTF-8/duplicate rejection, 65536-byte/16-depth/4096-node bounds, safe integers, semantic SHA-256, authenticated caller/audience/deadline and local owner grants. JSON cannot construct an admission.

deadline.description: Absolute UTC milliseconds: last permitted new business effect, not network timeout. Effective deadline is the intersection with receiver grant/original task/capability policy. No generic one-hour Goal limit; command/gateway keep their own existing limits.

maxDelegationDepth.description: Maximum total device edges since origin: A→B=1; A→B→C=2. No third edge in v1. PairGrant.allowDelegation=false still permits the paired peer to call directly.

budget.description: Stable native original-parent reservation identity, never authorization. Tool sessions keep one allocation across operations/runs/reconnect; Goal includes the original prepared operation. Receiver and owner grant lifetime pools never refill from new IDs.

localTaskId.description: Stable caller-chosen receiver session correlation; receiver_task_id maps it to an actual dt1_ local task. Predictability grants no authority.

protocolProfile.description: Required authoritative PocketWorld profile digest; unknown/missing profile is rejected before authorization. See profile.json.

then.description: New outer cancel operationId+digest; arguments.operationId+argumentsDigest bind the original SQL target. Current original caller peer/pin, C owner management capability/current resource, short native ticket and separate rate guard only. Source visibility/A continuing execution/historyRead cannot block this de-escalation. Never return original contents or execute new tools.

name.description: 1..160 Unicode scalar values, same native cache basename policy; reject C0 controls, path separators, colon, dot and dot-dot; no NFC rewrite.

runId.description: Optional genuine target execution run. Thin Companion without a target run omits runId/executorEpoch; no source run or invented epoch 1.

requestRunId.description: Original source request run correlation only, never target execution authority.

requestExecutorEpoch.description: Original source request epoch, paired with requestRunId.

targetResources.description: Exact authorized target/resource pairs. Never expand independent target/resource sets as a Cartesian product.

targetShares.description: A original native reservation freezes these non-overlapping B/C/D exact-resource shares. Tool/model sums <= signed source totals. Offline unused/unknown shares never migrate or refill. Stable shareId excludes run/epoch/signature/root/op.

targetResources.description: Exact authorized target/resource pairs. Never expand independent target/resource sets as a Cartesian product.

PairGrant.description: Native receiving-owner grant. Neither a serialized grant nor a device certificate constructs a Permission. allowDelegation governs acceptance of forwarded origins; separate optional forwardingScope explicitly governs onward use by an accepted Goal. Permission/spend authority must be checked against the original live SQLite rows and lifetime owner budget.

allowWholeDisplayInput.description: Independent from whole-display capture. Native execution still enforces current owner input scope and observed app-window binding.

HistoryReadPolicy.description: Explicit receiving owner result-reading retention, independent from execution expiresAt; <=30 days after grant issue. Missing means no independently retained read authority. Never authorizes new tools, controls, model calls or refunds.

rootTaskId.description: Immutable original accepted request root correlation, not target execution authority.

localTaskId.description: Immutable original accepted request local correlation, not a forged PC task or target run.

runId.description: Optional actual target run, only when one genuinely exists. Never copy a source request run or invent a PC TaskStore run.

executorEpoch.description: Actual target executor epoch, paired with optional runId; accepted-but-not-started and lightweight PC commands omit both.

argumentsDigest.description: Optional original accepted semantic digest from the same immutable original SQL record; required for operation management, never inferred from caller JSON.

AcceptedHistoryAudience.description: Immutable ORIGINAL SQL acceptance audience; never a wire factory for HistoryPermission. Current native source visibility, paired certificate/epoch/revocation and owner policy must still be checked. A fresh query has its own direct origin/caller, separate from this original action origin.

protocolProfile.description: Required authoritative PocketWorld profile digest; unknown/missing profile is rejected before authorization. See profile.json.

OperationReceipt.description: ORIGINAL SQLite facts, not proof of new authority or physical exactly-once. Accepted receipt binds original operation digest/audience/acceptedAt; optional target run is genuine. reported means native report, NOT business verification. Unknown/not_found never causes automatic replay/refund; client must match actual authenticated sender and original prepared wire. Native body remains opaque payload, not authority.

DeviceDescription.description: Paired-identity metadata via private DiscoveryPermission only, no dummy execution grant. Captured lifetime <=30s; signed receipts only for actual caller own current native SQL grants. Candidate/pending have zero access. Readiness metadata does not authorize execution.

x-canonicalization.numbers: safe signed integers only; decimals encoded as strings
x-canonicalization.strings: JSON minimal escapes; control characters lower-case hex
x-canonicalization.operationDigest: SHA-256 canonical entire request excluding requestId, operationId, argumentsDigest, traceId, replyCursor
x-canonicalization.decimalToolArguments: GUI pixels/session identifiers are safe integers. Fractional tools must advertise decimal strings in their tool schema; drivers must validate and convert without silent truncation.

x-identities.receiverTaskId: dt1_ + SHA256(canonical {protocolVersion,originDeviceId,callerDeviceId,targetDeviceId,messageType,rootTaskId,localTaskId,operationId only for GoalSubmission}); excludes run/attempt/signature/digest
x-identities.allocationId: ba1_ + SHA256(canonical {protocolVersion,parentTaskId,targetDeviceId,resourceBinding,kind=tool_session|goal,parentOperationId only for goal}); native only; no authorization
x-identities.forwardingAuthorization: Initial Goal only. Original caller signs after original parent budget reserve, binds receiverTaskId as parent. Receiver must have explicit forwardingScope. Final target independently verifies its own current PairGrant, original origin, scope and total-edge bound.

historyQueryPolicy.nativeFactory: OutgoingGrant.historyQuery / history_query, or restored read-only HistoryRoute from original signed outgoing-grant SQL and actual current mTLS peer
